serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Quick! The fashion show will soon begin!
You: Don’t worry, we still have a lot of time. Annalie needs to make some final adjustments anyway.
Bot: I know, but I just can’t help but get excited! I’ve never attended a fashion show, let alone participated in one.
You: Just don’t get too excited. You wouldn’t want to make some stupid mistake on the runway.
Bot: Don’t worry, I got it covered. I prepared a script that will take over my body so that external stimuli won’t impact my performance.
You: I have mixed feelings about this idea… Just do your best, ok?
Bot: Of course!
